mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM auth_permission p INNER JOIN auth_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN auth_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN auth_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.isdel = 0 AND rp.isdel = 0 AND ur.isdel = 0 AND r.isdel = 0 ORDER BY p.permission_code ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.permission_code AS permissionCode, p.permission_name AS permissionName, p.module, p.description, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.isdel FROM auth_permission p INNER JOIN auth_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN auth_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN auth_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.isdel = 0 AND rp.isdel = 0 AND ur.isdel = 0 AND r.isdel = 0 ORDER BY p.permission_code ASC

SELECT p.id, p.permission_code AS permissionCode, p.permission_name AS permissionName, p.module, p.description, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.isdel FROM auth_permission p WHERE p.isdel = 0
AND p.module = #{module}
AND p.permission_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{permissionCode}, '%')
AND p.permission_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{permissionName}, '%')
ORDER BY p.module ASC, p.permission_code ASC

SELECT rp.permission_id FROM auth_role_permission rp INNER JOIN auth_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id AND p.isdel = 0 WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND rp.isdel = 0 ORDER BY p.module ASC, p.permission_code ASC

SELECT p.id, p.permission_code AS permissionCode, p.permission_name AS permissionName, p.module, p.description, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.isdel FROM auth_permission p INNER JOIN auth_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND rp.isdel = 0 AND p.isdel = 0 ORDER BY p.module ASC, p.permission_code ASC
